verses.text: E enter boat, and cross over, and come to im own city.
Look, dem bring to am man wey dey paralyzed, dey lie on bed. Jesus, as e see dem faith, talk say to di paralytic, “My pikin, cheer up! Dem don forgive your sins.”
Look, some of di scribes talk say for dem heart, “Dis man dey blaspheme.”
Jesus, as e know dem thoughts, talk say, “Why una dey think evil for una hearts?”
“Because which one easy pass, to talk, ‘Dem don forgive your sins;’ or to talk, ‘Get up, and walk?’”
“But so that una go know say Son of Man get authority for earth to forgive sins,” den e talk say to di paralytic, “Get up, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
E rise and go to im house.
But when di multitudes see am, dem marvel and glorify God, wey don give men dis kind authority.
As Jesus dey pass from dat place, e see man wey dem dey call Matthew dey sit for di tax collection office. E talk say to am, “Follow me.” E get up and follow am.
E happen say as e dey sit for di house, look, plenty tax collectors and sinners come and sit down with Jesus and im disciples.
When di Pharisees see am, dem talk say to im disciples, “Why your teacher dey eat with di tax collectors and sinners?”
When Jesus hear am, e talk say to dem, “Dem wey dey healthy no need physician, but dem wey sick need am.”
“But una go learn wetin dis mean: ‘I want mercy, and no be sacrifice,’ because I no come to call di righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
Den John disciples come to am, and talk say, “Why we and di Pharisees dey fast often, but your disciples no dey fast?”
Jesus talk say to dem, “Di friends of di bridegroom fit mourn, as long as di bridegroom dey with dem? But days go come wey dem go take di bridegroom from dem, and den dem go fast.”
“Nobody dey put piece of unshrunk cloth on old garment; because di patch go tear away from di garment, and worse hole go form.”

“Neither people dey put new wine inside old wineskins, if no, di skins go burst, and di wine go spill, and di skins go spoil. No, dem dey put new wine inside fresh wineskins, and both go dey preserved.”
While e dey tell dem dis things, look, one ruler come and worship am, and talk say, “My daughter don just die, but come and lay your hand on am, and e go live.”
Jesus get up and follow am, with im disciples.
Look, woman wey get flow of blood for 12 years come from behind am, and touch di fringe of im garment;
because e talk say for im heart, “If I just touch im garment, I go dey well.”
But Jesus turn round and see am, and talk say, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith don make you well.” And di woman dey well from dat hour.
When Jesus come enter di ruler house, and see di flute players, and di crowd dey for noisy disorder,
e talk say to dem, “Make room, because di girl no die, but e dey sleep.” Dem ridicule am.
But when dem put di crowd out, e enter, take am by di hand, and di girl rise.
Di report of dis go out enter all dat land.
As Jesus dey pass from dat place, two blind men follow am, dey call out and talk say, “Show us mercy, David pikin!”
When e don enter di house, di blind men come to am. Jesus talk say to dem, “Una believe say I fit do dis?” Dem tell am, “Yes, Lord.”
Den e touch dem eyes, and talk say, “Make am happen to una according to una faith.”
Dem eyes open. Jesus warn dem strictly, and talk say, “See say nobody know about dis.”
But dem leave and spread im fame for all dat land.
As dem dey go out, look, dem bring mute man wey get evil spirit to am.
When dem don cast di evil spirit out, di mute man talk. Di multitudes marvel, and talk say, “Dem never see anything like dis for Israel!”
But di Pharisees talk say, “By di prince of di evil spirits, e dey cast out evil spirits.”
Jesus dey go round all di cities and di villages, dey teach for dem synagogues, dey preach Good News of di Kingdom, and dey heal every disease and every sickness among di people.
But when e see di multitudes, e get compassion for dem, because dem dey distressed and downcast, like sheep wey no get shepherd.
Den e talk say to im disciples, “Di harvest plenty, but di laborers few.”
“So pray to di Lord of di harvest, so that e go send out laborers enter im harvest.”
E call im 12 disciples to imself, and give dem authority over evil spirits, to cast dem out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
Now di names of di 12 apostles na dis: First, Simon, wey dem dey call Peter; Andrew, im brother; James, Zebedee pikin; John, im brother;
Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew di tax collector; James, Alphaeus pikin; Lebbaeus, wey im surname na Thaddaeus;
Simon di Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, wey also betray am.
Jesus send dis 12 out, and command dem, and talk say, “No go among di Gentiles, and no enter any city of di Samaritans.”
“Instead, go to di lost sheep of di house of Israel.”
“As una dey go, preach, and talk say, ‘Kingdom of Heaven don near!’”
“Heal di sick, cleanse di lepers, raise di dead, cast out evil spirits. Una receive am free, so give am free.”
“No take gold, or silver, or brass for una money belts.”
“No take bag for una journey, or two coats, or sandals, or staff: because di laborer worthy of im food.”
“Any city or village wey una enter, find out who dey inside wey worthy, and stay for dat place until una leave.”
“As una dey enter di household, greet am.”
“If di household worthy, make una peace come on am, but if e no worthy, make una peace return to una.”
“Whoever no receive una, and no hear una words, as una dey leave dat house or dat city, shake di dust from una feet.”
“Most certainly I tell una, e go dey more tolerable for di land of Sodom and Gomorrah for di day of judgment than for dat city.”
“Look, I dey send una out like sheep among wolves. So make una wise like serpents, and harmless like doves.”
“But beware of men: because dem go hand una over to councils, and for dem synagogues dem go flog una.”
“Yes, and dem go bring una before governors and kings because of me, for testimony to dem and to di nations.”
“But when dem hand una over, no dey anxious how or wetin una go talk, because dem go give una for dat hour wetin una go talk.”
“Because no be una dey talk, but na una Papa God Spirit dey talk inside una.”
“Brother go hand brother over to death, and di papa im pikin. Pikin dem go rise up against dem papa and mama, and make dem put dem to death.”
“All men go hate una because of my name, but di one wey endure to di end go dey saved.”
“But when dem persecute una for dis city, run go di next, because most certainly I tell una, una no go finish go through di cities of Israel until Son of Man don come.”
“Disciple no dey above im teacher, and servant no dey above im oga.”
“E enough for di disciple say e be like im teacher, and di servant like im oga. If dem don call di oga of di house Beelzebul, how plenty more dem wey dey im household!”
“So no fear dem, because nothing covered dey wey dem no go reveal, and nothing hidden wey dem no go know.”
“Wetin I tell una for darkness, talk am for light; and wetin una hear dem whisper for ear, proclaim am for di housetops.”
“No fear dem wey kill di body, but no fit kill di soul. Instead, fear di one wey fit destroy both soul and body for Gehenna.”
“Dem no dey sell two sparrows for one assarion coin? Not one of dem go fall to di ground without una Papa God will,”
“but di very hairs of your head all don number.”
“So no fear. Una worth more pass plenty sparrows.”
“So everyone wey confess me before men, I go also confess am before my Papa God wey dey heaven.”
“But whoever deny me before men, I go also deny am before my Papa God wey dey heaven.”
“No think say I come to send peace on di earth. I no come to send peace, but sword.”
“Because I come to set man against im papa, and di daughter against im mama, and di daughter-in-law against im mother-in-law.”
“Man foes go be dem wey dey im own household.”
“Di one wey love papa or mama pass me no worthy of me; and di one wey love son or daughter pass me no worthy of me.”
“Di one wey no take im cross and follow me no worthy of me.”
“Di one wey find im life go lose am; and di one wey lose im life because of me go find am.”
“Di one wey receive una receive me, and di one wey receive me receive di one wey send me.”
“Di one wey receive prophet for di name of prophet go receive prophet reward. Di one wey receive righteous man for di name of righteous man go receive righteous man reward.”
“Whoever give one of dis small ones just cup of cold water to drink for di name of disciple, most certainly I tell una, e no go lose im reward at all.”
When Jesus don finish to direct im 12 disciples, e leave dat place to teach and preach for dem cities.
Now when John hear for prison di works of Christ, e send word by im disciples
and talk say to am, “Na you be di one wey dey come, or make we look for another?”
Jesus answer dem, “Go and tell John di things wey una hear and see:”
“di blind dey receive dem sight, and di lame dey walk, di lepers dey cleanse, and di deaf dey hear, di dead dey raise up, and di poor dey hear good news preach to dem.”
“Blessed na di one wey no find reason to stumble inside me.”
As dem dey go dem way, Jesus begin to talk say to di multitudes about John, “Wetin una come out go see for di wilderness? Reed wey wind dey shake?”
“But wetin una come out go see? Man wey wear soft clothing? Look, dem wey dey wear soft clothing dey kings houses.”
“But why una come out? To see prophet? Yes, I tell una, and plenty more pass prophet.”
“Because na dis man dem write about, ‘Look, I dey send my messenger before your face, wey go prepare your way before you.’”
“Most certainly I tell una, among dem wey women born, anybody wey great pass John di Baptizer never rise; yet di one wey least for Kingdom of Heaven great pass am.”
“From di days of John di Baptizer until now, Kingdom of Heaven dey suffer violence, and di violent dey take am by force.”
“Because all di prophets and di law prophesy until John.”
“If una dey willing to receive am, dis na Elijah, wey go come.”
“Di one wey get ears to hear, make e hear.”
“But wetin I go compare dis generation to? E be like pikin dem wey dey sit for di marketplaces, wey dey call to dem companions”
“and talk say, ‘We play flute for una, and una no dance. We mourn for una, and una no lament.’”
“Because John come, e no dey eat or drink, and dem talk say, ‘E get evil spirit.’”
“Son of Man come dey eat and drink, and dem talk say, ‘Look, glutton, and drinker of wine; friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom dey justified by im pikin dem.”
Den e begin to reproach di cities wey dem do most of im mighty works inside, because dem no repent.
“Woe dey for you, Chorazin! Woe dey for you, Bethsaida! Because if dem do di mighty works for Tyre and Sidon wey dem do for una, dem go don repent long time ago for sackcloth and ashes.”
“But I tell una, e go dey more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon, for di day of judgment, than for una.”
“You, Capernaum, wey dem don exalt reach heaven, you go go down to Hades. Because if dem do di mighty works for Sodom wey dem do for you, e go don remain until dis day.”
“But I tell una say e go dey more tolerable for di land of Sodom, for di day of judgment, than for you.”
For dat time, Jesus answer, “I thank you, Papa God, Lord of heaven and earth, say you hide dis things from di wise and understanding, and reveal dem to infants.”
“Yes, Papa God, because na so e please you for your sight.”
“My Papa God don hand all things over to me. Nobody know di Pikin, except Papa God; and nobody know Papa God, except di Pikin, and di one wey di Pikin choose to reveal am to.”
“Come to me, all una wey dey labor and dey heavily burdened, and I go give una rest.”
“Take my yoke upon una, and learn from me, because I dey gentle and humble for heart; and una go find rest for una souls.”
“Because my yoke dey easy, and my burden dey light.”
For dat time, Jesus pass through di grain fields on di Sabbath day. Im disciples dey hungry and begin to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
But di Pharisees, when dem see am, talk say to am, “Look, your disciples dey do wetin no lawful to do for di Sabbath.”
But e talk say to dem, “Una never read wetin David do, when e dey hungry, and dem wey dey with am;”
“How e enter di house of God, and eat di show bread, wey no lawful for am to eat, and no lawful for dem wey dey with am, but only for di priests?”
“Or una never read for di law, say for di Sabbath day, di priests for di temple dey profane di Sabbath, and dem no guilty?”
“But I tell una say one wey great pass di temple dey here.”
“But if una don know wetin dis mean, ‘I want mercy, and no be sacrifice,’ una no go don condemn di guiltless.”
“Because Son of Man na Lord of di Sabbath.”
E leave dat place, and enter dem synagogue.
Look, man dey wey get withered hand. Dem ask am, “E lawful to heal for di Sabbath day?” so that dem go accuse am.
E talk say to dem, “Which man dey among una, wey get one sheep, and if dis one fall enter pit for di Sabbath day, e no go grab am, and lift am out?”
“How plenty more man worth pass sheep! So e lawful to do good for di Sabbath day.”
Den e tell di man, “Stretch out your hand.” E stretch am out; and e restore whole, just like di other one.
But di Pharisees leave, and conspire against am, how dem go destroy am.
Jesus, as e perceive dat, withdraw from dat place. Great multitudes follow am; and e heal dem all,
and command dem say dem no go make am known:
so that wetin dem talk through Isaiah di prophet go dey fulfilled, wey talk say,
“Look, my servant wey I don choose; my beloved wey my soul dey well pleased with: I go put my Spirit on am. E go proclaim justice to di nations.”
“E no go strive, or shout; and nobody go hear im voice for di streets.”
“E no go break bruised reed. E no go quench smoking flax, until e lead justice to victory.”
“For im name, di nations go hope.”
Den dem bring to am one wey evil spirit dey inside, blind and mute, and e heal am, so tay di blind and mute man both talk and see.
All di multitudes dey amazed, and talk say, “Dis one fit be David pikin?”
But when di Pharisees hear am, dem talk say, “Dis man no dey cast out evil spirits, except by Beelzebul, di prince of di evil spirits.”
As e know dem thoughts, Jesus talk say to dem, “Every kingdom wey divide against imself dey come to desolation, and every city or house wey divide against imself no go stand.”
“If Satan cast out Satan, e don divide against imself. Den how im kingdom go stand?”
“If I cast out evil spirits by Beelzebul, na by who una pikin dem dey cast dem out? So dem go be una judges.”
“But if I cast out evil spirits by God Spirit, den God Kingdom don come upon una.”
“Or how person go enter di house of di strong man, and plunder im goods, unless e first bind di strong man? Den e go plunder im house.”
“Di one wey no dey with me dey against me, and di one wey no dey gather with me dey scatter.”
“So I tell una, every sin and blasphemy go dey forgiven men, but di blasphemy against di Spirit no go dey forgiven men.”
“Whoever talk word against Son of Man, dem go forgive am; but whoever talk against Holy Spirit, dem no go forgive am, no for dis age, and no for di one wey go come.”
“Either make di tree good, and im fruit good, or make di tree corrupt, and im fruit corrupt; because dem dey know di tree by im fruit.”
“Una pikin dem of vipers, how una fit, wey dey evil, talk good things? Because from di abundance of di heart, di mouth dey talk.”
“Di good man from im good treasure dey bring out good things, and di evil man from im evil treasure dey bring out evil things.”
“I tell una say every idle word wey men talk, dem go give account about am for di day of judgment.”
“Because by una words dem go justify una, and by una words dem go condemn una.”
Den some of di scribes and Pharisees answer, “Teacher, we want to see sign from you.”
But e answer dem, “Evil and adulterous generation dey seek sign, but dem no go give am sign except di sign of Jonah, di prophet.”
“Because as Jonah dey three days and three nights for di belly of di huge fish, so Son of Man go dey three days and three nights for di heart of di earth.”
“Di men of Nineveh go stand up for di judgment with dis generation, and go condemn am, because dem repent for di preaching of Jonah; and look, one wey great pass Jonah dey here.”

“Di queen of di south go rise up for di judgment with dis generation, and go condemn am, because e come from di ends of di earth to hear di wisdom of Solomon; and look, one wey great pass Solomon dey here.”
“But di evil spirit, when e don leave di man, e dey pass through waterless places, dey seek rest, and e no dey find am.”
“Den e talk say, ‘I go return enter my house wey I come out from,’ and when e don come back, e find am empty, swept, and put in order.”

“Den e dey go and take seven other spirits wey dey more evil pass am with imself, and dem enter and live for dat place. Di last state of dat man become worse pass di first. Even so e go be for dis evil generation too.”
While e still dey talk to di multitudes, look, im mama and im brothers dey stand outside, dey seek to talk to am.
One talk say to am, “Look, your mama and your brothers dey stand outside, dey seek to talk to you.”
But e answer di one wey talk to am, “Who be my mama? Who be my brothers?”
E stretch out im hand toward im disciples, and talk say, “Look, my mama and my brothers!”
“Because whoever do di will of my Papa God wey dey heaven, na im be my brother, and sister, and mama.”
For dat day Jesus come out from di house, and sit by di seaside.
Great multitudes gather to am, so tay e enter boat and sit, and all di multitude dey stand for di beach.
E talk plenty things to dem for parables, and talk say, “Look, farmer leave go sow.”
“As e dey sow, some seeds fall by di roadside, and di birds come and devour dem.”
“Others fall on rocky ground, wia dem no get plenty soil, and immediately dem spring up, because dem no get depth of earth.”
“When di sun don rise, e scorch dem. Because dem no get root, dem wither away.”
“Others fall among thorns. Di thorns grow up and choke dem.”
“Others fall on good soil, and yield fruit: some 100 times as much, some 60, and some 30.”
“Di one wey get ears to hear, make e hear.”
Di disciples come, and talk say to am, “Why you dey talk to dem for parables?”
E answer dem, “Dem don give una to know di mysteries of Kingdom of Heaven, but dem no give dem.”
“Because whoever get, dem go give am more, and e go get abundance, but whoever no get, dem go take away from am even wetin e get.”
“So I dey talk to dem for parables, because as dem dey see, dem no dey see, and as dem dey hear, dem no dey hear, and dem no dey understand.”
“For dem di prophecy of Isaiah dey fulfilled, wey talk say, ‘By hearing una go hear, and una no go understand at all; and by seeing una go see, and una no go perceive at all:’”

“‘Because dis people heart don dull, dem ears dey dull for hearing, and dem don close dem eyes; if no, dem fit perceive with dem eyes, hear with dem ears, understand with dem heart, and turn again, and I go heal dem.’”
“But blessed na una eyes, because dem dey see; and una ears, because dem dey hear.”
“Because most certainly I tell una say plenty prophets and righteous men want to see di things wey una dey see, and dem no see dem; and to hear di things wey una dey hear, and dem no hear dem.”
“Hear den, di parable of di farmer.”
“When anybody hear di word of di Kingdom, and no understand am, di evil one dey come, and snatch away wetin dem don sow for im heart. Dis na wetin dem sow by di roadside.”
“Wetin dem sow for di rocky places, dis na di one wey hear di word, and immediately with joy receive am;”
“yet e no get root inside imself, but e endure for small time. When oppression or persecution rise because of di word, immediately e stumble.”
“Wetin dem sow among di thorns, dis na di one wey hear di word, but di cares of dis age and di deceitfulness of riches choke di word, and e become unfruitful.”
“Wetin dem sow for di good ground, dis na di one wey hear di word, and understand am, wey most certainly bear fruit, and bring forth, some 100 times as much, some 60, and some 30.”
E set another parable before dem, and talk say, “Kingdom of Heaven be like man wey sow good seed for im field,”
“but while people dey sleep, im enemy come and sow darnel weeds too among di wheat, and leave.”
“But when di blade spring up and bring forth fruit, den di darnel weeds appear too.”
“Di servants of di householder come and talk say to am, ‘Oga, you no sow good seed for your field? Wia dis darnel come from?’”
“E talk say to dem, ‘Enemy don do dis.’ Di servants ask am, ‘You want make we go gather dem up?’”
“But e talk say, ‘No, so that, as una dey gather up di darnel weeds, una no go root up di wheat with dem.’”
“‘Make both grow together until di harvest, and for harvest time I go tell di reapers say: First, gather up di darnel weeds, and bind dem for bundles to burn dem; but gather di wheat enter my barn.’”
E set another parable before dem, and talk say, “Kingdom of Heaven be like grain of mustard seed, wey man take, and sow for im field;”
“wey indeed small pass all seeds. But when e don grow, e great pass di herbs, and e become tree, so that di birds of di air go come and lodge for im branches.”
E talk another parable to dem. “Kingdom of Heaven be like yeast, wey woman take, and hide for three measures of flour, until all of am don leaven.”
Jesus talk all dis things for parables to di multitudes; and without parable, e no talk to dem,
so that wetin dem talk through di prophet go dey fulfilled, wey talk say, “I go open my mouth for parables; I go utter things hidden from di foundation of di world.”
Den Jesus send di multitudes away, and enter di house. Im disciples come to am, and talk say, “Explain to us di parable of di darnel weeds of di field.”
E answer dem, “Di one wey dey sow di good seed na Son of Man,”
“and di field na di world; and di good seed, dem na di pikin dem of di Kingdom; and di darnel weeds na di pikin dem of di evil one;”
“and di enemy wey sow dem na di devil. Di harvest na di end of di age, and di reapers na angels.”
“So as dem dey gather up di darnel weeds and burn dem with fire; so e go be for di end of dis age.”
“Son of Man go send out im angels, and dem go gather from im Kingdom all things wey dey cause stumbling, and dem wey do iniquity,”
“and go throw dem into di furnace of fire. Wailing and gnashing of teeth go dey.”
“Den di righteous go shine forth like di sun for di Kingdom of dem Papa God. Di one wey get ears to hear, make e hear.”
“Again, Kingdom of Heaven be like treasure hidden for di field, wey man find, and hide. For im joy, e dey go and sell all wey e get, and buy dat field.”
“Again, Kingdom of Heaven be like man wey na merchant wey dey seek fine pearls,”
“wey when e find one pearl of great price, e leave go sell all wey e get, and buy am.”
“Again, Kingdom of Heaven be like dragnet, wey dem throw enter di sea, and e gather some fish of every kind,”
“wey, when e don full, dem drag up for di beach. Dem sit down, and gather di good ones inside containers, but di bad ones dem throw away.”
“So e go be for di end of di world. Di angels go come forth, and separate di wicked from among di righteous,”
“and go throw dem into di furnace of fire. Di wailing and di gnashing of teeth go dey for dat place.”
Jesus talk say to dem, “Una don understand all dis things?” Dem answer am, “Yes, Lord.”
E talk say to dem, “So every scribe wey dem don make disciple for Kingdom of Heaven be like man wey na householder, wey dey bring out from im treasure new and old things.”
E happen say, when Jesus don finish dis parables, e leave from dat place.
As e come to im own country, e teach dem for dem synagogue, so tay dem dey astonished, and talk say, “Wia dis man get dis wisdom, and dis mighty works?”
“Dis no be di carpenter pikin? Dem no dey call im mama Mary, and im brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?”
“All im sisters no dey with us? Den wia dis man get all dis things?”
Dem take offense for am. But Jesus talk say to dem, “Prophet no dey without honor, except for im own country, and for im own house.”
E no do plenty mighty works for dat place because of dem unbelief.
